about: ImageDraw.Draw(rgb, 'RGBA').line(xy, fill=rgba, width=...): particle trails and speed lines
note: args: mode and size (width, height) of the image, background (its one colour before the call) or the array "in", xy as passed (xy_form "pairs": a list of (x, y) tuples; "flat": one list x0, y0, x1, y1, ...), then the keyword arguments of the call exactly as passed (a keyword that is absent was not passed). Floats are float.hex() strings. Arrays are (height, width) for L and F, (height, width, 3) for RGB, (height, width, 4) for RGBA; F is float32. Pillow truncates every coordinate toward zero to a C int before drawing, and an F ink to float32. Here the image is RGB and the drawing mode is "RGBA": every pixel the shape covers becomes the blend of the pixel and the ink by the ink's alpha, once per time it is drawn. "in" is the image before the call.
